0x00079C.en: 「So... this is as far as I go...!」

0x0007CE.en: 「At my level now...@　this is the limit...!」

0x00083F.en: 「Gah!@　This is as far as I go...!!」

0x0008C7.en: 「Damn it!@　You won't get me next time!」

0x000941.en: 「Is this... as far as I go...?」

0x000A28.en: 「Oh dear...@　how uncool of me, honestly!」

0x000A9C.en: 「Nngh, this is as far as I go!」

0x000B2C.en: 「Like hell I'll blow it here...!@　This ain't fun...」

0x000B80.en: 「Blew it...!@　Guess I have to bail...」

0x000BF4.en: 「Gah! I've got no choice but to fall back!!」

0x000C6A.en: 「This is as far as I go......!」

0x000CD1.en: 「This is the end... I leave the rest to you.」

0x000D03.en: 「Damn it...!@ This is as far as I go!」

0x000D7D.en: 「No good, took too many hits...... Retreating!」

0x000DCA.en: 「Well, I'm beaten. I'll leave the rest to you.」

0x000E08.en: 「Kyah, I leave the rest to you!」

0x000E4F.en: 「The Granzon... shot down, of all things......」

0x000EFA.en: 「Nngh...... To think I'd become a shooting star...... I'm ejecting!」

0x000F79.en: 「I-I can't take any more of this......!」

0x000FB1.en: 「Owowow...... I give up, miscalculation on my part.」

0x001036.en: 「U...ngh! This is as far as I go...!」

0x0010A3.en: 「Nngh! All hands, abandon ship at once!!」

0x0010EA.en: 「I'm sorry, I leave the rest to you.」

0x00111F.en: 「Damn it! Is this the limit of my power...!」

0x00120B.en: 「To go down in a place like this...@　How careless of me...!」

0x001259.en: 「No good, this is as far as I go! I'm pulling back!」

0x001314.en: 「Sorry, the rest is up to you!」

0x001381.en: 「Good grief, so this is where it ends.」

0x0013B0.en: 「I can't take any more. If you'll excuse me.」

0x00143B.en: 「So I let my guard down...@　I'm pulling back for now...!」

0x0015A1.en: 「Bailing out...@　Ngh...! Not a graceful exit...」

0x00165F.en: 「Guhh! Not in a place like this!!」

0x0017CE.en: 「So I still have a way to go...!」

0x001927.en: 「General Kirkus's scheme was beyond@　anything we anticipated...」

0x001996.en: 「Not just seizing power by backing Prince Terius...@　but aiming to unify all of La Gias.」

0x001A22.en: 「If it works out, La Gias might@　end up at peace... but@　a great war would break out first.」

0x001AAF.en: 「Whatever his goals or cause, there's a serious@　problem with how he means to achieve them.」

0x001B26.en: 「Did Prince Feil accept the General's offer@　knowing all of this...?」

0x001BA6.en: 「He likely judged that, as things stand,@　repelling the Shutedonias army is impossible@　without borrowing Kirkus's strength.」

0x001C42.en: 「Without liberating Langran first,@　nothing that comes after can happen.」

0x001CB3.en: 「But... if Prince Feil recognized Prince@　Terius's accession as a stopgap for the@　immediate crisis...」

0x001D55.en: 「Then Feil's and Kirkus's forces might@　end up fighting each other later, right...?」

0x001DDC.en: 「Different nation or not, I too am of royal blood.@　I understand full well what a claim to@　the throne means.」

0x001E78.en: 「In my own Duchy of Ricsent, there was a@　dispute over succession back in the Old@　Calendar era. Though it never came to war...」

0x001F2C.en: 「Those around Prince Feil must have fiercely@　opposed his decision.」

0x001F9A.en: 「For him to override them, give up his own@　claim to the throne, and recognize Prince@　Terius's accession...」

0x002033.en: 「Beyond ending this war, there must be some@　other reason... some extraordinary resolve.」

0x0020FC.en: 「You mean Prince Feil has some other@　purpose too...?」

0x002158.en: 「Yeah... After I deliver you all to Zeb Shrine,@　I intend to confirm it myself. The Prince@　should be in the royal capital now.」

0x002206.en: 「Masaki and the others@　may be there too.」

0x002256.en: 「Hey, can't you check over the comm?」

0x002296.en: 「The Ether flow is growing turbulent again.@　Long-range communication is difficult right now.」

0x002301.en: 「Besides, without securing Zeb Shrine, we won't@　be able to send you and the other@　surface-dwellers home.」

0x002388.en: 「If the General's got the return prep ready,@　wouldn't his men be guarding the place?」

0x00241A.en: 「I'd think so... but Louzorl's movements@　worry me.」

0x00246D.en: 「With their help, there are likely other@　hidden Shutedonias units still out there.」

0x0024F1.en: 「Hey, Yang Long. Let me come too...」

0x002522.en: 「I can't drag you in any further. Gennacy and I@ will take responsibility for finding the rest@ of the Steel Dragon Squadron.」

0x002629.en: Holy Langran Kingdom - Ballantyne State - Zeb Shrine

0x0026EB.en: 「Captain!@　There seems to be fighting near Zeb Shrine!」

0x002741.en: 「Yang Long's prediction was right. All hands,@　battle stations one. Hold course,@　ahead full both engines, battle speed three!」

0x002816.en: 「I already got the Mechanical Soldiers' data.@ For my Avenir, this is a piece of cake.」

0x002899.en: 「Just hurry up and go down already.」

0x0028C7.en: 「I only came to scout... but looks like I can@　put them down surprisingly easily.」

0x00292C.en: 「Now, what should I do... Assuming the prep's done, if I@　head back to the surface first, Chienne and@　Chien'll be furious...」

0x0029CE.en: 「Ah... just as I thought, they came here.」

0x002A33.en: 「That machine...@　it's one of the three that attacked us on the surface.」

0x002AED.en: 「Those are the shrine's guardian Mechanical Soldiers.」

0x002B64.en: 「The Mechanical Soldiers are unmanned.@ Is it possible he's hacked in and is controlling them?」

0x002BEB.en: 「You! You're with that Chienne and Chien!@　Just who the hell are you!?」

0x002C53.en: 「And why, back then... did you attack us?」

0x002C93.en: 「I've got no reason to tell you that.」

0x002CCD.en: 「Then what did you come here for?」

0x002CFE.en: 「Heard I could get back to the surface, so I came to scout a little.」

0x002D47.en: 「Who told you that?@　Surely not General Kirkus?」

0x002DA9.en: 「...I'll just tell you this much:@　I'm not one of Langran's people.」

0x002E02.en: 「Since you came all this way, the story must@　be true. I hate hassle, so I'm heading back.@　See ya.」

0x002F13.en: 「At this rate the shrine will be caught up in it!@ No choice, we destroy the Mechanical Soldiers!」

0x002F7B.en: 「Mechanical Soldiers, all units have ceased functioning.」

0x002FAF.en: 「...Those brats are the ones hired by@　Shutedonias. Where the hell did they@　catch wind of this?」

0x00304E.en: 「To control the Mechanical Soldiers, you'd have to@ get hold of their data first...」

0x0030B9.en: 「That Kerberion of his looked like an@ electronic-warfare model, so maybe he@ scanned them on the spot?」

0x00314C.en: 「Or maybe he heard it from Louzorl, who's@　cooperating with Shutedonias...」

0x0031C6.en: 「Captain, Kirkus's Masou Kishin are@ approaching. Types are Galguard, Gadifall,@ and Browel.」

0x003265.en: 「Galguard...? Why is General Kirkus's@　own machine here?」

0x0032C1.en: 「...I doubt General Kirkus would come here.@　Who's piloting the Galguard?」

0x00338B.en: 「I deserted from my father's side. Some comrades@　who feared his forceful methods@　helped me escape.」

0x00342A.en: 「D-deserted...? Even as the General's son,@　if you do something like that!」

0x00348C.en: 「I'm prepared for it.@　I have no intention of going back to my father.」

0x00350D.en: 「...I've already decided. I'm going to stick@　with you and the others, Yang Long.@　That's all right, isn't it, Lune?」

0x0035A3.en: 「Huh? Why ask me?@　Shouldn't that be Yang Long?」

0x0035FC.en: 「Uh... um... anyway, glad to be working with you all.」

0x003661.en: 「Zash, are you really sure? One wrong step@　and you could end up fighting@　your own father.」

0x0036E5.en: 「Whether he's my father or not doesn't matter.@　As a soldier of the Langran army, I want to@　stop what General Kirkus is trying to do.」

0x003799.en: 「Hmm... that's pretty cool of you, kid.」

0x003882.en: 「Know him? More than that.@　He's my boyfriend.」

0x0038CF.en: 「Whoa, when'd you two get so close? So,@　you've at least been on a date?」

0x00396B.en: 「What, why the sudden temper? If you're@　a couple, you'd go on a date or two.」

0x003A08.en: 「That guy's no boyfriend of mine or anything!」

0x003AC3.en: 「W-w-would you, um, that is,@　maybe g-g-go on a d-date with me sometime...?」

0x003B53.en: 「Ah, right, of course...@　Someone like me's no good after all...」

0x003C2F.en: 「After this battle's over. But I've got@　one condition.」

0x003CBC.en: 「You absolutely must NOT@　stand me up on our date!」

0x003D12.en: 「That's all? Leave it to me!@　No matter what, I'll keep that promise!」

0x003D89.en: 「Well, I've got to report to Colonel Lefina,@　so I'll be off!」

0x003DF1.en: 「No, wait. In that case, I'll come too.」

0x003E84.en: 「Actually... you don't even know@　where the Captain's quarters are, do you.」

0x003EE6.en: 「...That's love at first sight, all right.」

0x003F2A.en: 「See, last time we met he talked casual, but@　now it's all polite. And Zash is the older one.@　Bet feisty, tomboyish girls are right up his alley.」

0x00401B.en: 「No, no, Leona and Lune are as different@　as a <PT> and a <Super Robot>」

0x0040D4.en: 「Wait, that actually makes sense to you?」

0x004111.en: 「...If he'd met Lieutenant Katina first,@　he might've fallen for her instead.」

0x004182.en: 「I don't mind that type, honestly.@　The wishy-washy part bugs me a little,@　but drill him hard and he'll shape up.」

0x004230.en: 「P-please, stop that.@　He's a promising young man...」

0x004289.en: 「Hey, just what's that supposed to mean!?」

0x0042C0.en: 「But is this really okay...? Setting up a date.」

0x004303.en: 「Masaki's probably blown off a date@　with Lune before, that's my guess.」

0x004371.en: 「And he's so dense, a little excitement's good for him, right?@　It's fun to watch, too.」

0x004404.en: （Not that you've got any room to talk.）
